scope: Mac-only task lifecycle boundary, current/history separation and interrupted-write recovery
implementedContract: TaskRunStore exposes exactly one non-archived current task record and a separately sorted archived history.
A second foreground task is rejected unless it arrives through the explicit user-session activation boundary.
Completing a user-owned session archives the matching task without treating model-side run completion as task completion.
A new user session after completion receives a new task identity; the old task, work items, runs and events remain in history.
If the app stopped after a new session was saved but before the old task was archived, synchronization archives the older task at the new session start time.
A delayed older session cannot replace a newer foreground task or modify the persisted bytes.
